caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical lantern with a metallic appearance, featuring a conical top and vertical sides. The lantern appears to be made of a dark brown or black metal, with two horizontal bands reinforcing the body. The front of the lantern has a hinged rectangular door with a small latch for access, and there are two translucent yellowish or cream-colored panels on either side of the door, allowing light from inside to pass through. The top of the lantern includes a domed cap with a round handle loop attached at the peak, oriented upward, suggesting a design for carrying or hanging. On either side of the sloped roof near the base of the cap, there are small vented sections with multiple circular holes, likely for ventilation. The background is a plain, light beige color and the image is rendered with soft shading and outlining. Near the bottom right of the lantern, the initials "M.A.R.S." are inscribed in small text.
title: Dormer Window Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
